risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, clearly identifying a 13.0% sales decline, a 59.4% operating-income decline, and substantial COVID-19-related impairment and restructuring charges. Liquidity commentary is confident, citing $117.8 million of cash and $450 million of borrowing capacity, but relies on forward-looking assumptions regarding future operations, earnings generation, covenant compliance, and actuarial estimates.
